tp-base: honeycomb sheet until the stir, then small rosettes that stay apart
tp-squeeze: round packed sheet, cells overlapping: held by the pull to the dish centre
tp-adh-hi: round packed sheet, re-forms after the stir
tp-nosense: flat honeycomb sheet, cells barely move, re-forms
th-base: a honeycomb sheet that holds until the stir; afterwards it stays broken into rosettes of 3-7 cells a cell-width apart
th-adhgene-0: single cells spread evenly, like a gas
th-adhgene-0.25: single cells and a few pairs
th-adhgene-0.4: single cells, pairs, a few triplets
th-adhgene-0.8: round honeycomb sheet; heals after the stir
th-adhgene-1: round honeycomb sheet; heals after the stir
th-adh-2.4: round sheet packed tighter, cells overlapping a little
th-adhbase-0: flat honeycomb sheet, very still inside
th-motgene-0.5: sheet holds; the stir leaves two or three pieces that do not rejoin in 40 s
th-motgene-2: fast crawlers scatter as single cells and pairs
th-crawl-0: a still honeycomb sheet; heals slowly after the stir
th-crawl-1.5: single cells everywhere, the widest scatter of all
th-size-1.15: looser sheet, breaks into pieces after the stir
th-senseoff: the stillest honeycomb sheet; heals completely
th-emitoff: as field A not felt: a still honeycomb sheet
th-sense-3: sheet holds; the stir splits it into two pieces
th-lever-0.2: a compact rounded sheet, cells slightly overlapping (long beat: one smooth attracting bump)
th-lever-0.8: pairs, triplets and short worms (short beat: rings at one cell spacing)
th-key-0.08: the tightest round sheet (key almost the medium's: very long beat)
th-key-0.8: round sheet (46 deg is 14 deg from the hex lattice's 60: a longer beat than the baseline)
th-anchor-0: the reference's sliding moire: small groups and chains
th-anchor-2: beat still in the world: loose groups
th-r0-3.5: a wider field envelope: scattered pairs and triplets
th-Boff: as the baseline (field B carries no charge here: stocks are empty)
th-Bfate: a compact round MORULA-like ball, cells pressed and overlapping; neighbours keep changing (liquid drop)
th-Bfate-repel: every cell keeps its distance: an evenly spaced lattice of single cells (a crystal of loners)
th-excl3: rosettes and small clumps of 3-10, apart
th-ellipse: oval cells in curved bead-chains and small clumps
th-shape-soft: sheet with a ragged rim; the stir breaks it into pieces
th-shape-stiff: sheet with clean straight walls; heals after the stir
th-snap-1: sheet of rounder cells with small gaps between them; heals
th-kicksoff: a constant jitter (stronger than the dark dish's heat): loose clump, frays after the stir
th-jitter-0: as the baseline (the dark dish's heat kicks are already tiny)
th-warm: a warm dish: branched loose network
th-drift-0.5: the medium's flow pulls the sheet into a comet with a tail; breaks after the stir
th-stiff-3: soft contacts (and so weaker glue, which scales with the contact stiffness): single cells
th-stiff-14: hard contacts (stronger glue): a still sheet
th-squeeze: packed round sheet held by the pull to the centre
th-fate-muscle: pink sheet of slightly stretched cells
th-n100: a sheet that frays at the rim
th-n300: a large honeycomb sheet with a frayed rim budding rosettes and short chains
tc-base: after the stir the culture splits in two: one clump on each spring (cells smell the fuel)
tc-lightoff: one clump between the two springs
tc-full: two clumps, one on each spring
tc-lambda-9: a loose band between the springs
tc-qstockoff: one big ball sitting on a spring (field B per fate: everyone attracts)
tc-pump-share: two clumps on the springs, the lower one tight
tt-same: control: types differ only in engines; one mixed sheet, breaks after the stir
tt-dah: green (sticky) core with a partial gold rim; the extra gold cells wander off alone
tt-key-7deg: partly sorted: green and gold patches inside loose clumps
tt-key-17deg: fully sorted into separate single-type islands, green and gold apart
tt-mot: the fast gold cells scatter, green stays in small groups
tt-size: mixed sheet, the large gold cells a little toward the rim
tt-dah-senseoff: mixed islands, gold toward the rim; nobody moves enough to sort
tt-key-excl: fully sorted single-type islands (other key = other exclusion state)
tt-dah-agg: from scattered: small green clumps with gold cells stuck on the outside
tt-key-agg: from scattered: small mostly single-type clumps
tt-dah-100: a green sheet with gold cells clinging along its edges and many gold loners around it
tq-adh08-excl3: thick branching ribbons (bands two to three cells wide)
tq-adh1-excl2-nosense: RIBBONS: straight two-cell-wide strips, like ladders or brickwork
tq-adh08-Brepel-100: single cells and pairs, evenly spaced
tq-adh1-Brepel-100: ISLETS: evenly spaced small rosettes and triads (3-7 cells), each a cell-width or more from the next
tq-adh08-sense40: the strong field wins: clumps break, single cells
tq-adh1-mot2: round sheet: the stronger glue holds the fast crawlers
tq-adh08-ellipse: an elongated cobblestone of oval cells, all aligned like a palisade
tq-Bfate-senseoff: a tight ball of pressed cells, still
tq-Bfate-mot2: a ball whose cells keep swapping places (liquid)
tq-Bfate-excl3: one large clump with a few satellite rosettes
tq-Bfate-clockside: a ball whose cells keep swapping places
tq-Bfate-adh0: a loose cloud held only by the long-range pull: cells never keep their neighbours
tq-agg-base: from scattered: single cells, pairs, triplets
tq-agg-adh08: from scattered: 6 small sheets of 4-12 that stay apart (no long-range pull to merge them)
tq-agg-adh1-nosense: from scattered: small still sheets that stay apart
tq-agg-Bfate: from scattered: gathers into a few balls (the long-range pull brings them together)
tq-agg-Bfate-adh08: from scattered: two or three balls
tq-dah-Bfate: CORE AND SHELL: green sticky core wrapped in a gold shell one cell thick
tq-dah-nosense-100: one mixed sheet, frozen: no motion to sort
tq-key17-Bfate: TWO-DOMAIN tissue: one ball, half green half gold (Janus)
tk-dah-Bfate-100: CORE AND SHELL at 100 cells: a green core wrapped in a gold rim one to two cells thick (a few gold cells still inside)
tk-key17-Bfate-100: STRIPED two-domain ball: green and gold bands side by side (three green patches between gold)
tk-adh1-excl2-nosense-100: a LACE SHEET: cells in a square checkerboard packing, with holes; ribbons joined into a net
tk-dah-Bfate-agg: from scattered: mixed clumps with gold cells on the outside, merging slowly
tk-key17-Bfate-agg: from scattered: small clumps, mostly one colour each, drawing together
